run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the largest subarray with equal 0s and 1s in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets and print success count
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which uses a hash map and prefix sum to find equal 0/1 subarrays
review_f_gold: review f_gold for its in-place array mutation of 0s to -1s and non-0s to 1s
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid mutating the input array and return start and end indices
